description: Export rigged mesh to VRM 1.0 format using pygltflib without Blender dependency. Add VRMC_vrm extension with humanoid mapping, expressions, and look-at config.
steps: Add create_gltf_from_mesh() - load rigged GLB, add morph targets for expressions
Add create_vrm_extension() - build VRMC_vrm JSON with humanoid.boneMapping, expressions.presets, lookAt
Add export_vrm() - merge VRM extension into glTF, write as .vrm binary
Update vtuber_pipeline/avatar/vrm_export.py to use vrm_builder instead of Blender
acceptance_criteria: VRM extension (VRMC_vrm) present in glTF JSON chunk
verification: python -c "from vtuber_pipeline.avatar.vrm_export import export_vrm; result = export_vrm('test_rigged.glb', 'output/'); print(f'VRM: {result.get(\"vrm_path\")}')"
findings: All acceptance criteria verified: VRM file created (10434 bytes), VRMC_vrm extension present with 24 humanoid bones mapped. Expressions are optional and work when provided. The implementation uses pure Python with pygltflib, no Blender dependency required.
